awards:
第25届圣丹斯电影节(2009)
　　评审团大奖 世界电影单元剧情片(提名)
introduction: Heart of Time permeates the uncharted territory of Chiapas state, in Mexico, at the core of the Zapatistas’ struggle for autonomy. Sonia is about to get married, the families of the couple-to-be have settled all the details, and the dowry – limited to a single cow – has been agreed upon. However, Sonia is in love with someone else, a fighter of the guerrilla army. EZLN is now bound to object to the wedding; the entire community is seeking ways to resolve the matter, asking for its voice to be heard, with the hope that love will overcome repression.源自：https://www.filmfestival.gr/en/section-tiff/movie/1253/14586
